articles.title: Spacewalking astronauts unfurl upgraded solar array to boost space station power
articles.summary: NASA astronaut Anil Menon and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Joshua Kutryk successfully installed and unfurled the seventh of eight new solar panels designed to power the outpost through its retirement in 2030.
